hack.root_cause: ERC4626 Donation Attack (Vault Inflation / Zero Exchange Rate)
hack.description: ResupplyFi lost $9.8M in two hours when an attacker donated spare change to a freshly deployed vault, inflated its share price to infinity, and borrowed the entire market with 1 wei of collateral.
